scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/computer-use/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/desktop/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/host/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/helper/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client-settings/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/voice/tsconfig.json
